title: U-2 on the deck of the USS Kitty Hawk, 5 August 1963
description: Black-and-white photograph of a U-2 parked on an aircraft carrier flight deck beside the island superstructure bearing hull number "63"; the aircraft's tail reads "O.N.R." and "N315X." Captioned "U-2 on the USS Kitty Hawk, 5 August 1963." Chapter 5 text (page 249) notes the first successful carrier landing on 2 March 1964 and begins the section "Use of Carrier-Based U-2 To Film a French Nuclear Test Site."
